summary: Windows LockFileEx advisory locks allow the same process to re-acquire the same byte range via different file handles. fd-lock alone does not serialize intra-process concurrent connect_db calls. Retry back-off is required as the second safety net.

When estimating worst-case backoff for exponential retry: sum all intervals explicitly. 20 attempts at 25ms→500ms cap: 25+50+100+200+400+(500*15)=8275ms≈7.8s, not 5s. Document the actual sum in doc comments, not a rough estimate.
